view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and fluorescent lighting. Multiple forklifts are parked on concrete flooring near tall metal racks filled with stacked boxes and pallets. Yellow safety barriers are placed around equipment. The space is organized but busy with industrial activity.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift with 'REWE' branding is parked on the left side of the frame. It has a black seat and steering wheel. Its front bumper is visible, and it's positioned near yellow safety barriers. The forklift is stationary and partially obstructed by a stack of black crates.

objects.label: stack of black crates
objects.observation: A tall, rectangular stack of black plastic crates sits on a wooden pallet in the center-left area. Each crate has white labels. The stack is positioned between the forklift and a metal rack. It is supported by the pallet and appears stable.

objects.label: metal warehouse rack
objects.observation: A tall, gray metal rack extends vertically from the floor to the ceiling on the right side. It holds multiple levels of boxes and pallets. The rack is bolted to the floor and wall, providing structural support for stored goods.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic barriers are placed on the floor near the forklifts and racks. They appear freestanding and are used to define safe zones. One is directly behind the orange forklift, another is near the central stack of crates.

objects.label: second orange forklift
objects.observation: Another orange forklift is parked on the right side, closer to the foreground. It has a black seat and steering wheel. It is positioned near a metal rack and appears stationary. A person is seated inside the cab.

objects.label: third orange forklift
objects.observation: A third orange forklift is visible further back on the far right, partially obscured by the second forklift. It is similar in design and color. Its position suggests it is parked near storage racks.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s5-35822", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
